# Emergence catalogue

<!-- Generated by `pnpm scenarios:docs` from tests/scenarios/*.json; do not edit by hand. -->

Each scenario is a replayable combination of ordinary world properties in the greybox chaos room
(`?scene=chaos-room`): the game fires real stimuli at props and the element rules, plates and ropes
do the rest. Outcomes are properties read at ticks (60 ticks per second), never entity types. CI
replays every scenario (`tests/integration/emergence-scenarios.test.ts`) and compares its final
state hash with a golden; a broken combo names its scenario and what the player would have seen.
New combos found in playtests are added as a file in `tests/scenarios/`; `pnpm scenarios:bless`
records the golden hash and `pnpm scenarios:docs` regenerates this page.

14 scenarios.

## Light the brazier, then douse it

<a id="brazier-lit-then-doused"></a>

You set a flame to an unlit brazier and it flares up. A splash of water puts it out again.

Setup: The unlit brazier on the fire station.

Inputs:
- tick 10: heat stimulus of 600 at fire-brazier (radius 0.5 m)
- tick 70: water stimulus of 5 at fire-brazier (radius 1 m)

Outcomes:
- tick 60: The brazier is lit. (`burning` of fire-brazier eq true)
- tick 120: The brazier is out. (`burning` of fire-brazier ne true)

## A burning load burns away and the plate releases

<a id="burning-straw-releases-plate"></a>

A straw bale sits on a pressure plate and holds it down. You set the bale alight. The plate stays down while it burns, and clicks back up only once the bale has burnt to nothing.

Setup: A plate with a straw bale (a crate of straw with a short fuel) resting on it.

Inputs:
- tick 30: heat stimulus of 600 at combo-burden-crate (radius 0.5 m)

Outcomes:
- tick 20: The plate is held down by the bale. (`plate.active` of combo-plate-burden eq true)
- tick 120: The bale is burning. (`burning` of combo-burden-crate eq true)
- tick 120: The plate is still down while the bale burns. (`plate.active` of combo-plate-burden eq true)
- tick 400: The bale has burnt away. (`alive` of combo-burden-crate eq false)
- tick 400: The plate has released. (`plate.active` of combo-plate-burden eq false)

## A dropped chandelier trips the plate beneath it

<a id="chandelier-trips-plate"></a>

A pressure plate sits on the floor under the chandelier. You burn the rope; when the chandelier lands, the plate clicks down under its weight.

Setup: The chandelier's rope plus the plate directly under it.

Inputs:
- tick 10: set fuel of combo-rope to 2
- tick 10: heat stimulus of 600 at combo-rope (radius 0.5 m)

Outcomes:
- tick 60: The plate is up while the chandelier hangs above it. (`plate.active` of combo-plate-chandelier eq false)
- tick 600: The plate is pressed down by the fallen chandelier. (`plate.active` of combo-plate-chandelier eq true)
- tick 600: The plate carries the chandelier's weight. (`plate.weight` of combo-plate-chandelier gte 10)

## A flame thaws a frozen crate, but the wet wood will not light

<a id="flame-thaws-frozen-crate-but-wet-wood-wont-burn"></a>

You soak a crate and freeze it solid, then play a flame over it. The ice melts away, but the crate is still so wet it never catches fire.

Setup: A crate on the freeze station.

Inputs:
- tick 10: water stimulus of 1 at freeze-crate-1 (radius 0.5 m)
- tick 20: cold stimulus of 60 at freeze-crate-1 (radius 0.5 m)
- tick 70: heat stimulus of 600 at freeze-crate-1 (radius 0.5 m)

Outcomes:
- tick 60: The crate is frozen solid. (`frozen` of freeze-crate-1 eq true)
- tick 1300: The ice has melted. (`frozen` of freeze-crate-1 eq false)
- tick 1300: The wet crate never caught fire. (`burning` of freeze-crate-1 ne true)

## A melting ice block lets the plate up

<a id="ice-block-melts-off-plate"></a>

A block of ice sits on a pressure plate and holds it down. You hold a flame to it. The block stays frozen but shrinks as it melts, and the plate clicks back up while the ice is still there, once too little of it is left to press.

Setup: A plate (it needs 20 kg) with a 60 kg ice block resting on it.

Inputs:
- tick 30: heat stimulus of 200 at combo-ice-slab (radius 1 m)

Outcomes:
- tick 20: The plate is held down by the ice. (`plate.active` of combo-plate-ice eq true)
- tick 20: The block is still ice. (`frozen` of combo-ice-slab eq true)
- tick 120: The block has shrunk as it melts. (`weight` of combo-ice-slab lt 50)
- tick 120: There is still plenty of ice on the plate. (`weight` of combo-ice-slab gt 20)
- tick 120: The plate is still down while enough ice is left. (`plate.active` of combo-plate-ice eq true)
- tick 250: The block is still ice, only smaller. (`frozen` of combo-ice-slab eq true)
- tick 250: Too little ice is left to press the plate. (`weight` of combo-ice-slab lt 20)
- tick 250: The plate has clicked back up, with the ice still there. (`plate.active` of combo-plate-ice eq false)
- tick 450: The block has melted through. (`frozen` of combo-ice-slab eq false)
- tick 450: Nothing is left to weigh on the plate. (`weight` of combo-ice-slab eq 0)
- tick 450: The plate stays up. (`plate.active` of combo-plate-ice eq false)

## Heat melts the ice block

<a id="ice-block-thaws-when-heated"></a>

A block of ice stands on the freeze station. You hold a flame to it. It stays frozen a while, soaking up the heat, then melts through.

Setup: The ice block on the freeze station.

Inputs:
- tick 10: heat stimulus of 200 at freeze-ice-block (radius 1 m)

Outcomes:
- tick 20: The block is still ice. (`frozen` of freeze-ice-block eq true)
- tick 700: The block has thawed. (`frozen` of freeze-ice-block eq false)

## Light the oil barrel and the fire runs down the row

<a id="oil-barrel-chain-ignition"></a>

A barrel of oil stands beside two crates. You light the barrel; its flames heat the nearest crate until it ignites, and that one lights the next. The identification crates across the room are far enough to stay cold.

Setup: The oil barrel and two crates in a row on the west side, with the identification line well away.

Inputs:
- tick 10: heat stimulus of 600 at chain-barrel (radius 0.5 m)

Outcomes:
- tick 300: The barrel burns. (`burning` of chain-barrel eq true)
- tick 90: The first crate catches from the barrel within a second or two. (`burning` of chain-crate-a eq true)
- tick 300: The first crate keeps burning. (`burning` of chain-crate-a eq true)
- tick 300: The second crate catches from the first. (`burning` of chain-crate-b eq true)
- tick 300: The crates on the far wall are untouched. (`burning` of all of the `ident` spawns ne true)

## Cold freezes the wet crate and leaves the dry one

<a id="only-wet-things-freeze"></a>

You soak one crate and chill both it and a dry crate beside it. The wet crate freezes solid; the dry one just gets cold.

Setup: Two crates on the freeze station, one soaked first.

Inputs:
- tick 10: water stimulus of 1 at freeze-crate-1 (radius 0.5 m)
- tick 20: cold stimulus of 60 at freeze-crate-1 (radius 0.5 m)
- tick 20: cold stimulus of 60 at freeze-crate-2 (radius 0.5 m)

Outcomes:
- tick 60: The wet crate is frozen solid. (`frozen` of freeze-crate-1 eq true)
- tick 60: The dry crate is not frozen. (`frozen` of freeze-crate-2 ne true)
- tick 60: The dry crate has only chilled. (`temperature` of freeze-crate-2 lt 15)

## Burn the rope, the chandelier falls

<a id="rope-burns-chandelier-falls"></a>

You set a flame to the rope that holds the chandelier. The hemp burns through and the chandelier drops to the floor.

Setup: The rope and chandelier hanging in the open centre of the room.

Inputs:
- tick 10: set fuel of combo-rope to 2
- tick 10: heat stimulus of 600 at combo-rope (radius 0.5 m)

Outcomes:
- tick 60: The rope is on fire. (`burning` of combo-rope eq true)
- tick 60: The chandelier still hangs while the rope burns. (`suspended` of combo-chandelier eq true)
- tick 600: The chandelier has come loose from the burnt rope. (`suspended` of combo-chandelier eq false)
- tick 600: The chandelier lies on the floor. (`position.y` of combo-chandelier lt 1.5)

## A soaked crate will not burn

<a id="soaked-crate-refuses-to-burn"></a>

You douse one crate with water, then hold the same flame to it and to a dry crate beside it. The dry one burns; the soaked one only steams.

Setup: Two crates on the fire station, one soaked first.

Inputs:
- tick 10: water stimulus of 5 at fire-crate-1 (radius 1 m)
- tick 20: heat stimulus of 600 at fire-crate-1 (radius 0.5 m)
- tick 20: heat stimulus of 600 at fire-crate-2 (radius 0.5 m)

Outcomes:
- tick 300: The dry crate burns. (`burning` of fire-crate-2 eq true)
- tick 300: The soaked crate does not catch. (`burning` of fire-crate-1 ne true)
- tick 15: The crate is soaked through. (`wetness` of fire-crate-1 gte 0.5)

## Straw burns away; wood leaves charcoal

<a id="straw-burns-away-wood-chars"></a>

You light a haystack and a wooden crate with the same flame and let them burn out. The straw is gone without a trace; the crate remains as charred wood.

Setup: A haystack and a crate on the fire station, with short fuel so they burn out quickly.

Inputs:
- tick 10: set fuel of fire-haystack to 5
- tick 10: set fuel of fire-crate-2 to 5
- tick 10: heat stimulus of 600 at fire-haystack (radius 0.5 m)
- tick 10: heat stimulus of 600 at fire-crate-2 (radius 0.5 m)

Outcomes:
- tick 60: The crate is burning. (`burning` of fire-crate-2 eq true)
- tick 900: The haystack has burnt away entirely. (`alive` of fire-haystack eq false)
- tick 900: The crate is still there. (`alive` of fire-crate-2 eq true)
- tick 900: The crate is blackened, charred wood. (`material` of fire-crate-2 eq charred)

## Water puts a burning crate out

<a id="water-douses-burning-crate"></a>

A crate is burning. You throw water on it and the flames die, leaving the crate wet.

Setup: A crate on the fire station.

Inputs:
- tick 10: heat stimulus of 600 at fire-crate-3 (radius 0.5 m)
- tick 70: water stimulus of 5 at fire-crate-3 (radius 1 m)

Outcomes:
- tick 60: The crate is burning. (`burning` of fire-crate-3 eq true)
- tick 120: The flames are out. (`burning` of fire-crate-3 ne true)
- tick 80: The crate is wet. (`wetness` of fire-crate-3 gt 0.1)

## Charge runs through a puddle into a soaked crate

<a id="wet-charge-chain"></a>

An iron anvil, a puddle and two crates touch one another. You soak one crate, then shock the anvil. The charge runs through the puddle into the soaked crate. The dry crate beside the puddle takes none.

Setup: The anvil, puddle and two crates in the east pocket, all touching the puddle.

Inputs:
- tick 10: water stimulus of 5 at combo-wet-crate (radius 1 m)
- tick 40: charge stimulus of 600 at combo-anvil (radius 0.5 m)

Outcomes:
- tick 42: The soaked crate crackles with charge. (`charge` of combo-wet-crate gt 10)
- tick 42: The dry crate stays quiet. (`charge` of combo-dry-crate eq 0)

## A soaked crate holds the fire back for a while

<a id="wet-crate-delays-the-fire"></a>

You soak the first crate beside the oil barrel before lighting the barrel. The fire has to dry the crate out before it can catch, so it spreads far more slowly than it would to a dry crate, but the heat gets there in the end.

Setup: The oil barrel and two crates in a row on the west side.

Inputs:
- tick 10: water stimulus of 5 at chain-crate-a (radius 0.5 m)
- tick 40: heat stimulus of 600 at chain-barrel (radius 0.5 m)

Outcomes:
- tick 100: The barrel is burning. (`burning` of chain-barrel eq true)
- tick 100: The soaked crate is only steaming. (`burning` of chain-crate-a ne true)
- tick 100: The far crate has not caught yet. (`burning` of chain-crate-b ne true)
- tick 600: The crate has dried out and caught. (`burning` of chain-crate-a eq true)
- tick 600: The fire has reached the far crate. (`burning` of chain-crate-b eq true)
